_comment: Place naming as DATA (the same split as streets.json): the C++ (world/place_names.h) owns the
algorithm, this file the words. Glenn, 2026-09-25: 'I'll leave it to you to generate the town
names. They don't have to be Hawaiian.' A name is a ROOT + an ENDING run together (Ash + ford ->
Ashford), and a place's SITE can shape it: a coastal town may be 'Port ...' or '... Bay', a town on
a river '... Ford' or '...bridge', the mountain town '... Ridge'. Each word is used once per world
while the banks last; the same world seed always gives the same names.
routes: what the island's roads are signed as, and the two directions round a ring road (the
Capital Beltway's convention: the INNER loop runs clockwise, the OUTER counter-clockwise).
